The memory system stores information as markdown files with YAML frontmatter organized into three categories: knowledge (facts and patterns), session (session summaries), and execution (action logs). Search is powered by tantivy BM25 full-text indexing, which is rebuilt from files at startup. The memory_search tool is the primary recall mechanism and is essentially free since it operates locally. Post-processing includes dedup detection and quality scoring.
